samples.query: How do I download a capital gains statement?
samples.answer: Download a capital gains / loss statement for your mutual fund holdings from the registrar's self-service request page, the Statements section of camsonline.com, where you choose the period, delivery option and fund houses to include. The statement is sent to the email address already registered with your folio, so no personal details need to be shared here.

samples.answer: Download a mutual fund account or transaction statement from the AMC's official investor portal, investor.hdfcfund.com, using its statement request service to choose your date range. You sign in to your own account on the portal itself, so nothing personal needs to be shared here.
